definitions: A person or thing that floats.
A person who moves from job to job or place to place.
A small, dark, shadowy shape that appears to drift across the field of vision, caused by cells or fragments in the vitreous humour of the eye.
A type of loan or bond with a variable interest rate.
A ballot paper that has been deliberately left blank or spoiled so that it can be used fraudulently.
examples: The floater was easily visible against the bright sky.
She worked as a floater, covering different departments.
He noticed a floater in his left eye.
They invested in a floater to hedge against inflation.
The election was marred by reports of floater ballots.
